verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a merchant's data. The closest items are adjacent: 'advanced analytics' and 'valuable insights' are not described as AI-generated, the 'AI-driven solution' automatically optimizes acceptance rather than surfacing insights to the user, and the MCP server lets an external IDE agent query payments outside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
